_note: P1 step 1 farming (刘邦, SGODOT-239, q(59) §1.1 / §1.4). garden.plots: plot id → [col, row] on the garden grid, shared by the server (sprinkler coverage) and the client (P0Garden places plot [col, row] at PLOT_ORIGIN + 2 × [col, row]); 0–29 are P0's 6 × 5 and never move, 30–39 the two new columns on the right, row by row. How many of them the homestead has is 哪吒's homestead.plots (Lv1 30, Lv3 40; ids past 30 come as wild). facilities.kinds.sprinkler: stands on one empty plot, waters the ring of 8 around it on the grid (diagonals included, fewer at the edge), so a covered plot grows as it is sown; ripening there is cut by grow_cut, with Compost's 20% capped at grow_cut_cap together; how many may stand is homestead.sprinkler_max (3 + Homestead level, at most 10). workbench.recipes: the Sprinkler blueprint (to: field, built in place by the place command, never crafted; the Facilities tab comes from its tab, workbench belongs to 周瑜's line). farming.conveniences: the Farming level a convenience comes at (§4.6.1; harvest_all Lv9: harvest takes every ripe annual in the garden row underfoot at once, 0 Energy, q(118) ④; seed_saver Lv10: a harvest of a general annual — not regional, not perennial — gives back 1 seed of its kind with seed_saver_chance). goods.fert_orchard: Orchard Feed (§5.5), sold at the Market from Farming Lv7, 10 a day; on a tree that has been picked, halves its regrowth once (shop: market puts it on the Market's shelf).
